summary: Learn RAG for enterprise knowledge management with practical labs, evaluation methods, and governance templates. Book your course today.
lede: Retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise knowledge management combines retrieval from trusted content with large language model generation to produce more grounded answers, reduce hallucinations, and surface relevant internal information without retraining a model. This course shows you how to apply the approach across fragmented repositories, wikis, policy libraries, and other enterprise content sources. You will learn to map content, define chunking and metadata rules, design retrieval pipelines, and assess quality through precision-at-k, recall, and answer-grounding checks. You will also create a retrieval design brief and evaluation scorecard while exploring hybrid retrieval, reranking, observability, and access-control-aware retrieval at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, architect, govern, or improve enterprise knowledge retrieval workflows and need reliable methods for grounding AI responses in trusted content.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise content management, search or knowledge base operations, and basic AI concepts. You should be comfortable reading structured documentation and discussing retrieval quality, metadata, and user-facing knowledge workflows. Technical readiness: No coding is required for course completion, but familiarity with spreadsheet-based analysis or analytics dashboards will help. Participants may benefit from prior exposure to vector search, document governance, or prompt design, but these are introduced in a practical and operational way.
